title: How can I refine my search from URL query string
body:
How can I refine my search from URL query string, so that whatever color I want to select by default can be selected from URL through query string.

Example : http://*********/shop/desk-accessories/desk-pads/?refinement=color:black

The above URL should auto select from my selected result for black color.

comments.body:
Did you check out the urlSync option in the InstantSearch initialiser? 

https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html#struct-InstantSearchOptions-urlSync

See also: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2636

Thanks Haroenv.
Can you suggest the same when we click on any filter option the same should be binded in URL so that we can copy the URL and forward to our customer based on our selection.
Hello @ankitachetu if you set `urlSync` to true, this should be already the case, you will be able to share URLs
